heroes.Name: The Flash (Barry Allen)
heroes.Passive: Momentum Building | +10% critical chance per turn (stacks until end of stage).
heroes.Description: The Scarlet Speedster and the man who defines what the Flash legacy means, Barry Allen gained his powers in a lab accident when lightning struck a shelf of chemicals. His connection to the Speed Force gives him access to velocities that bend the rules of physics, time, and causality itself. Barry is optimistic and methodical where other speedsters are impulsive, a forensic scientist at heart who approaches every problem with evidence and reason. His sacrifice in Crisis on Infinite Earths is one of the defining moments in DC history.

heroes.Name: Iron Man MK VII
heroes.Passive: Mark VII | Applies Burn on every hit. On crit, applies an additional Burn stack.
heroes.Leader: Avenger Initiative | +10% ATK and +15% HP to all Avenger allies.
heroes.Description: This is Tony Stark at the Battle of New York — at the moment he flew a nuclear weapon into a wormhole fully expecting it to be one-way. The Mark VII is the suit that responded to Natasha's wristbands and launched itself onto Tony mid-fall, an emergency deployment that bought the seconds the city needed. It represents Tony at his most reckless and most necessary simultaneously. He made the sacrifice play without being asked, which shattered his own argument that he was not that kind of person.

heroes.Name: Asagi Igawa
heroes.Flavor Text: I fight so others don't have to.
heroes.Passive: Lightning Taimanin | +40% crit chance passively. On every critical hit apply Shock and Bleed simultaneously.
heroes.Leader: Black Taimanin | +20% ATK to all Taimanin allies.
heroes.Description: The legendary Black Taimanin and one of the most feared anti-demon operatives in the world. Born into the Igawa bloodline of elite ninja warriors, Asagi has fought on the front lines against demonic incursions since her teens. Her mastery of lightning techniques and close-quarters combat makes her nearly unstoppable in battle. She carries the weight of protecting humanity's future on her shoulders, even when it costs her everything.

heroes.Name: Poison Ivy (Shtora)
heroes.Flavor Text: The world will be green again.
heroes.Passive: Toxic | 50% chance on every hit to apply Poison stack. Enemy can have multiple Poison stacks each dealing 2% max HP per round.
heroes.Description: Pamela Isley surrounded by drifting autumn leaves.

heroes.Name: Robot
heroes.Passive: Logic Engine | +15% attack to all party members.
heroes.Description: Robot is one of the most coldly intelligent characters in the Invincible universe, a disembodied consciousness piloting remote-controlled suits who later transfers into a genetically engineered human body. His genius-level intellect and willingness to make decisions most heroes refuse to consider make him both the team's greatest tactical asset and its most existential threat. He genuinely believes his actions are for humanity's benefit, which makes him more unsettling than a simple villain. The series asks hard questions about what happens when the smartest person in the room decides they know better.

heroes.Name: Sakura Igawa
heroes.Flavor Text: I'll prove I can keep up with Sis.
heroes.Description: Asagi's younger sister and a Taimanin operative still carving out her own identity in her sibling's formidable shadow. Sakura has trained relentlessly to prove herself as more than just the lesser-known Igawa, developing a fierce fighting style that channels her determination into every strike. She idolizes Asagi while simultaneously burning to surpass her, a rivalry that drives constant growth. Those who underestimate her because of her age tend to learn their mistake quickly.

heroes.Name: Ingrid
heroes.Flavor Text: Every wound they carry makes them weaker. I make sure they carry many.
heroes.Passive: Iron Crusade | On every hit applies Marked to the enemy. Each Marked stack increases all damage taken by 3% (max 5 stacks / 15% total). Party-wide benefit.
heroes.Description: A crusader-type Taimanin known for relentless offensive pressure and the ability to exploit every weakness she exposes in her enemies. Ingrid fights with methodical precision, systematically marking targets so that every subsequent strike from her allies lands harder. Her Iron Crusade technique leaves enemies progressively more vulnerable with each blow, turning drawn-out battles into guaranteed victories. She operates with a cold efficiency that masks a deep-seated drive to eliminate every demonic threat she encounters.
